name: sveltekit-inline-remote-functions
description: Vite plugin that lets you write SvelteKit remote functions inline in .svelte components with <script remote>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external --sourcemap=linked && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run build
